annotation.title_clean: Se realizó el encuentro “Oportunidades y desafíos en Inteligencia Artificial”
annotation.title_en: The meeting "Opportunities and Challenges in Artificial Intelligence" was held
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Agencia I+D+i / Ministerio de Ciencia, Tecnología e Innovación (Argentina)
annotation.summary_en: Argentine government news item on an August 2023 workshop on AI opportunities and challenges, organised by the Science Ministry, Agencia I+D+i and the IDB. It covers a US$35 million IDB-backed AI funding programme, sectoral working groups (agroindustry, bioinformatics, logistics, mining), and the national CTI 2030 plan.
key_provisions_or_claims: IDB agreement of US$35 million to invest in AI for agriculture, medical equipment, industry and education
Plan Nacional de CTI 2030 includes AI as an axis
Working groups identified barriers: public-private articulation, scarce skilled personnel, data and compute capacity, ethical responsibility
Goal of public-private consortia calls for AI applications
80% of investment redirected to the interior of the country
